verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਬਾਹਮਣ ਸਾਰਸੁਤ ਵਿਰਤੀਸਰ ਲਾਗਾਇਤ ਲੋਏ।
verses.translit_en: kitaRe baahaman saarasut virateesar laagait loe|

en.bdb: Many brahmins of sarasuat gotra, priests and lagait (a south Indian sect) have existed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਗਉੜ ਕਨਉਜੀਏ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਢੋਏ।
verses.translit_en: kitaRe gauR kanauje'ee teerath vaasee karadhe ddoe|

en.bdb: Many are gaur, kanaujie  brahmins who reside in pilgrimage centres.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਲਖ ਸਨਉਢੀਏ ਪਾਂਧੇ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਵੈਦ ਖਲੋਏ।
verses.translit_en: kitaRe lakh sanaudde'ee paa(n)dhe pa(n)ddit vaidh khaloe|

en.bdb: Hundreds of thousands of people are called sanaudhie, pandhe, pandit and vaid.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਲਖ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਵੇਦ ਵੇਦੁਏ ਲੱਖ ਪਲੋਏ।
verses.translit_en: ketaRiaa(n) lakh jotakee vedh vedhue la'kh paloe|

en.bdb: Many hundreds of thousands are astrologers and many people will-versed in Vedas and the Vedic lore have been.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਲਖ ਕਵੀਸਰਾਂ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਭਾਟ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਉ ਬਖੋਏ।
verses.translit_en: kitaRe lakh kaveesaraa(n) braham bhaaT brahamaau bakhoe|

en.bdb: Hundreds of thousands of people are known by the names of brahmins, bhats (eulogists) and poets.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਅਭਿਆਗਤਾਂ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਲੈ ਕਨਸੋਏ।
verses.translit_en: ketaRiaa(n) abhiaagataa(n) ghar ghar ma(n)gadhe lai kanasoe|

en.bdb: Becoming mendicants many people undertaking spying work go on begging and eating.
Many are there who forecast about the good and bad omens and thus earn their livelihood.
